reviews.text:
Robert and his team were exceptional!!! They were very professional and did an amazing job replacing our damaged roof. He even helped with our insurance company with a claim for our roof. Great with providing updates and communicating with us.
I am so happy with his work and our new roof. I highly recommend this contractor. A++

Rob was an amazing contractor. We brought him in on to repair flood damage in the house. For multiple rooms, he installed drywall, wood flooring, and shoe molding, and he painted. His attention to detail was amazing and he would even come in on Saturday to apply extra coats of paint. He even negotiated with insurance to cover work the adjuster failed to include. My dog even loved him- that’s him laying on Rob’s feet!
